text.offer: Widow Qesino says, "My late husband fought in Castle Victoria when he was young, and never slept well after. The old king, Far'Nohl, went mad there, and his court walks it still. Drechx of the old council keeps a camp at its gates. If you're looking for a fight, dear, he'll have one for you."
text.complete: Drechx says, "Another one sent to me? Good. That castle needs cleansing, room by room, and I'm too old to do it myself."

steps.brief: Castle Victoria lies south of Tos, through the Cragged Mountains. You will have to cross Ukgoth, the Holy Land of Trolls, and find the castle in the north-west corner of that land. Run past any trolls or black spiders you are too weak to fight.

steps.objective: Talk to Drechx outside the castle
steps.brief: Drechx of the old council keeps watch outside the gates of Castle Victoria. Find him and talk to him.
